-- intro: :For the magic used by Cesc, see Shakudo Magic.  Copper Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and manipulate copper.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to generate and manipulate copper at will. The users are able to use this magic without the need of a grimoire. However, in order to use it to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires.
-- spell pages: Red Shine Mace
